description: One data row of central/data_quality.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8. Retired names: schema_version 2.0 renamed a column (org_id is now provider_account_id).

metric.description: Name of the data-quality metric. The metric unallocated_share is the not-a-person cost over the reference cost (cost_ref): it is not the reference unallocated share (the cookbook KPI one_unallocated_share), which is the one to report.

month.description: Calendar month, YYYY-MM; empty on the freshness metrics.

provider.description: Provider the usage or seats came from, as the silver records name it.

provider_account_id.description: Provider account label from the silver records; empty only where seats are matched on provider alone.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

value.description: Value of the metric, written in the metric's own type (count, money, ratio or date). The metric sets the type, not the column: read metric before you cast or sum.

title: gold-dataset-data_quality
x-cost-column-rule: `value` mixes counts, amounts, ratios and dates; read `metric` first and sum nothing across metrics.
x-grain: One row per month, provider, provider account and metric.
